title: Random lock chime
summary: Plays a random clip every time you lock. Add a folder named LockChime to your USB stick (any partition the car mounts) and fill it with short WAV clips: mono, 48 kHz, 16-bit. Needs a USB lock sound set in Toybox > Boombox > Lock Sound. Removing it restores your sound.

settings.title: USB folder name
settings.summary: Name of the folder holding your clips, on any partition of the USB stick the car mounts. Clips must be WAV, mono, 48 kHz, 16-bit (others are skipped), ideally under 5 seconds. To convert: ffmpeg -i in.mp3 -ac 1 -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_s16le -t 5 out.wav
